description: Default source priority table for conflict resolution during merge. Higher priority sources win for scalar fields; lower priority sources are merged for list fields.

notes.contact: ATS = employer record; Recruiter CSV = recent sales interaction
notes.employment: Resume = self-reported official history; LinkedIn = secondary confirmation
notes.skills: GitHub = demonstrated code + repo topics; Resume = self-reported
notes.headline: LinkedIn = curated professional summary
notes.years_experience: Resume date-derived = authoritative; LinkedIn = explicit self-report
